name: direction-replay-2026-10-19
hypothesis: Positive attributed short P&L may fail to survive removal of long trades because frozen actions depend on changed account state. Replay universally restricted policies before proposing direction specialists.
execution: Same SimulationConfig and profile-specific observations as source models; retain all original protective components. Each filtered path starts at initial equity and recomputes observations after actual restricted simulation fills.
selection: No checkpoint/model/mode selection or promotion; report every fixed cell, including unfavorable groups. Negative holding-stock cohort is reporting-only and never activates a filter.
deduplication: Within one run only: selected/final may share replay when full policy tensor, class and spaces fingerprints match; original weight file hashes and phase aliases remain recorded.

constraints.source_reports: Preserved; unrestricted replay must match original panel, paths and metrics within declared CPU tolerance

interpretation: A profitable short-only falling-stock subset cannot establish comparable all-market returns. This is a bounded diagnostic to guide a separately preregistered experiment.
